ops.body: Confirmed additional platform-specific write amplification: getconf PAGESIZE=16384 and direct32-byte reads of all three known authority-v1.db headers show16384-byte database pages. Bbolt v1.5.0 db.go262-264 defaults DB pages to OS pages; Linux hosted traces use4096. Isolated followup makes both authority creation paths explicitly4096 (Initialize and reindex building), matching existing measured Linux layout. No local benchmark/test. Actual savings unverified until official install/new-cache headers and affected reads checked.
